reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: The spec (INV-001) requires rejecting requests exceeding MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS. While the ByRoot handler lacks this validation (unlike ByRange at line 1148), the custody filter at rpc_methods.rs:423 prevents exploitation: `filter(|c| available_columns.contains(c))` ensures the node only processes columns it's custodian for (~16 columns per custody group, not 16384). The missing validation is a spec non-compliance but does not enable resource exhaustion DoS. The vulnerability claim assumes all 16384 columns would be processed, but custody filtering prevents this. Additionally, rate limiting at config.rs:122-124 caps DataColumnsByRoot to 16384 requests per 10 seconds at the network layer. Severity downgraded to Informational (spec compliance issue, not exploitable DoS).
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Fulu P2P SG-009 INV-001: No more than MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS may be requested. The handler correctly implements custody filtering but lacks explicit total-count validation per spec.
